text: Dunk baseline 2026-11-16 (estimated from athlete photos/video in the Monday chat, 8-in cinder-block rows as the ruler, about +/-3 cm; recorded 2026-11-22): standing reach 236 cm (93 in); standing jump-and-touch 300 cm (118 in), vertical 64 cm (25 in); approach jump-and-touch 304 cm (about 120 in), vertical 68 cm (27 in). Rim 305 cm (120 in): approach touch is about at rim height. A dunk needs a touch of roughly 320 cm (about 6 in above the rim), so about +16 cm (6 in) of approach vertical. Scored into the B0 baseline and B1 start test sets. Retest with a tape or chalk mark (inches in the reps box) at the transition week.
